content: It's now day 4, 7:44 — the plan's waits carried us forward. The pass opens tomorrow morning (day 5). The notice board interact failed on button id; I'll skip it (wiki already confirms the schedule) and instead stage near the pass gap so we're ready at dawn.

args.approach: It's day 4; pass opens day 5 morning. Skip the notice board (button id unknown, wiki already confirms schedule) and stage at the pass gap (11,3) overnight, then walk north up the east corridor to the chest at (11,1) and interact with it.
